_comment: #79 perf-loadtest BASELINE (RECORD-ONLY / Phase 1). These values are a STUB placeholder, NOT a measured baseline — promoting a real baseline is a deliberate manual commit after >=3 record-only runs on a stable snapshot pin establish a noise band (perf-loadtest-contract-2026-06-30.md 2.3). Until then the checker reports deltas but the harness NEVER gates (exits 0 regardless). snapshot_id / embedding_model MUST match the run for the comparison to be valid (2.5 incomparability guard); a stub snapshot_id ensures a live run is auto-flagged not-comparable until a real pin is recorded.

reproducibility.note: replace with a real run's reproducibility block when promoting a measured baseline
